edges.fact: MileagePlus is United Airlines' loyalty program, allowing members to earn and redeem miles for flights, upgrades, and other rewards
United Polaris is United Airlines' business class premium cabin
Premium Plus is a premium cabin offered by United Airlines that can be reached via upgrade awards
Economy Plus is United Airlines' premium economy product offering up to 5 inches more legroom, wider seats, and priority boarding for an extra $20-$100 per segment
United Airlines is a member of the Star Alliance
Star Alliance Gold is a status tier granted to United Airlines Platinum members, along with access to United Polaris lounges
Premier Silver is a MileagePlus status tier requiring 25,000 PQMs or 30 PQSs, offering priority check-in, security, boarding, and one free checked bag
Premier Gold is a MileagePlus status tier requiring 50,000 PQMs or 60 PQSs, offering two free checked bags, priority baggage handling, and Economy Plus access at check-in
Premier Platinum is a MileagePlus status tier requiring 75,000 PQMs or 90 PQSs, offering United Polaris lounge access, Star Alliance Gold status, and higher upgrade priority
Premier 1K is the top MileagePlus status tier requiring 100,000 PQMs or 120 PQSs, offering personalized service, dedicated check-in/security lines, and the highest upgrade priority
